title: Time-Left Credit on a Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Due Date Extension
content:
When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, a time-left credit is taken off the extension's days before they are counted. The time left is counted in calendar days from today to the current documents due date.

| Time left, today to the current documents due date | Credit taken off the extension's days |
|---|---|
| More than 40 calendar days | 5 days |
| More than 20 but not more than 40 calendar days | 2 days |
| 20 calendar days or fewer | None |

## Boundary rows (hypothetical; current documents due date Monday 12 October 2026)

| Today | Time left | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 September 2026 | 41 days | 5 days |
| 2 September 2026 | 40 days | 2 days |
| 21 September 2026 | 21 days | 2 days |
| 22 September 2026 | 20 days | None |

A request made with exactly 40 days left takes the 2-day credit, and one made with exactly 20 days left takes none, because each band starts only above its lower figure.
